# Paranoid OSINT Tool

A powerful command-line interface tool designed for security researchers to automate open-source intelligence gathering.

## Features
- Subdomain enumeration
- Email harvesting
- Port scanning integration

```bash
python Paranoid.py -t example.com
```
shortDesc: A comprehensive OSINT tool for gathering intelligence from public sources.
